title: Local balances dashboard
outcome: Running the app locally (pnpm run dev) and opening the page shows every account SimpleFin returns for the configured SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL, grouped by institution, with each account's current balance and currency. The access URL/credential never reaches the browser.

included: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) app scaffolded in this repo, joined to the js/ pnpm workspace, with working lint/typecheck/test/build scripts and scripts/verify-task.sh wired to them

A Server Component that reads SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL from a server-side-only env var, fetches SimpleFin's /accounts endpoint directly at request time, and renders the grouped-balances page server-side -- no client-side API route, no client-side fetch
Plain CSS (no styling framework) for milestone 1
The page blocks on the SimpleFin fetch and renders once complete -- no loading.tsx/Suspense streaming in milestone 1
Tests and manual verification run against SimpleFin's public demo bridge (https://demo:demo@beta-bridge.simplefin.org/simplefin), never a real linked account
A vitest test asserting the rendered page and any error output never contain the access URL substring or SimpleFin's raw auth header
excluded: Any client-side API route (e.g. app/api/accounts) or client-side fetch -- data flows server-side only
Any styling framework (Tailwind, etc.) -- plain CSS only; a later, separately-grilled milestone will research and implement proper UX/UI
loading.tsx or Suspense-based streaming loading states
Any deployment target (Vercel, etc.) -- local dev only
Multi-user auth or any login system
Using or requesting Adam's real SimpleFin access URL for any orchestrator task or verification step
Pushing commits anywhere -- the orchestrator commits locally on the dev branch only; no remote is configured for milestone 1

behaviors.description: With SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL pointed at SimpleFin's public demo bridge, running pnpm run dev and loading the page shows the demo accounts (Savings, Checking, Empty) grouped by institution, each with a balance and currency.

The page is server-rendered with no client-side API route or fetch; a vitest test asserts the rendered output and any thrown/logged error never contain the SimpleFin access URL or its embedded credential.
With SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL unset, loading the page shows a clear error state instead of an unhandled crash or a blank page.
If SimpleFin's API returns an auth error or is unreachable, the dashboard shows a clear error state instead of an unhandled crash or a silently empty account list.
